title: Kadison's similarity conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves Kadison's similarity conjecture: every bounded complex-linear unital algebra homomorphism from a unital complex C∗-algebra to operators on a Hilbert space becomes a *-homomorphism after conjugation by a bounded invertible operator.
problem_status_before: Kadison similarity problem (1955); Pisier's similarity degree
rating_reason: Settles one of the best-known operator-algebra problems.

title: Strong Kadison–Kastler stability and its spatial boundaries
one_line_claim: Proves that sufficiently close unital von Neumann algebras on the same Hilbert space are conjugate by a unitary arbitrarily close to the identity, with a universal tolerance in the operator-norm distance between unit balls.
problem_status_before: Kadison–Kastler conjecture (1972); injective case known
rating_reason: Settles a classical perturbation conjecture.

title: Relative bicentralizers and modular spectral recovery
one_line_claim: Proves Connes' bicentralizer conjecture for every type III1 factor with separable predual and every faithful normal state.
problem_status_before: Connes' bicentralizer problem (1980); Haagerup proved the injective case
rating_reason: Settles a famous type III question.

title: Cuntz comparison, nuclear dimension, and equivariant Jiang–Su stability
one_line_claim: Proves equivariant Jiang–Su stability for every countable discrete amenable group action on a simple separable unital infinite-dimensional nuclear stably finite Jiang–Su-stable C∗-algebra, resolving this case of Szabó's conjecture without restrictions on trace dynamics.
problem_status_before: Toms–Winter conjecture, central to the Elliott classification program; partial by Castillejos et al. (2021)
rating_reason: Closes the main structural conjecture of C*-classification in the unital case.

title: Kirchberg's O_2 norm-ultrapower embedding problem
one_line_claim: Constructs an explicit separable unital full group C∗-algebra that cannot embed unitally into the norm ultrapower of any fixed nonzero unital nuclear C∗-algebra, for any free ultrafilter on the natural numbers.
problem_status_before: Kirchberg's O₂ ultrapower question
rating_reason: Answers a known C*-algebra question negatively.

title: Invariant projections, hyperinvariant subspaces, and transitive algebras
one_line_claim: Constructs a nonzero norm-quasinilpotent operator on every infinite-dimensional separable complex Hilbert space with no nonzero proper closed subspace invariant under every commuting operator.
problem_status_before: Hyperinvariant subspace and transitive algebra problems for Hilbert space, open since the 1950s–60s
rating_reason: A transitive weakly closed proper operator algebra would answer a famous operator-theory problem negatively.

title: Kaplansky's quasitrace conjecture and failure of tensor-product stable finiteness
one_line_claim: Disproves Kaplansky's quasitrace conjecture by constructing a separable unital complex C∗-algebra admitting normalized 2-quasitraces, all of which are nonadditive.
problem_status_before: Kaplansky's QT = T question; Haagerup proved it for exact C*-algebras
rating_reason: Disproves a famous C*-algebra conjecture.

title: The Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves that every bounded Hochschild cocycle of degree at least two on a complex von Neumann algebra, with coefficients in the algebra itself, has a bounded primitive.
problem_status_before: Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture (1971); II₁ cases open
rating_reason: Settles a long-standing conjecture on bounded cohomology.

title: The generator problem for finite factors
one_line_claim: Proves that every type II1 factor with separable predual is generated by a single operator, equivalently by two self-adjoint operators, resolving the generator problem.
problem_status_before: Kadison's generator problem (1967)
rating_reason: Settles a famous von Neumann algebra problem.

title: A ZFC counterexample to Naimark's problem
one_line_claim: Gives an alternative to [Tanaka's ZFC construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26930v1) of a unital infinite-dimensional simple complex C∗-algebra with a faithful tracial state and exactly one nonzero irreducible representation up to unitary equivalence.
problem_status_before: Naimark's problem; Akemann–Weaver counterexample under ◊ (2004)
rating_reason: A ZFC counterexample; priority to Tanaka's concurrent arXiv construction is credited.

title: Two notions of free entropy differ even when both are finite
one_line_claim: Constructs a bounded self-adjoint tuple in a tracial von Neumann algebra whose microstates and nonmicrostates free entropies satisfy -∞< χ< χ^*< ∞. This answers Voiculescu’s finite-entropy equality question negatively: the matrix-approximation and free-Fisher-information definitions differ even when both are finite.
problem_status_before: Voiculescu's question on χ = χ*
rating_reason: Answers a free-probability question negatively.

title: The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion and infinite tensor-power Jiang–Su stability
one_line_claim: A nonzero unital separable complex C∗-algebra is Jiang–Su stable exactly when its norm central-sequence algebra has no characters, for every free ultrafilter.
problem_status_before: Kirchberg–Rørdam and Dadarlat–Toms questions
rating_reason: Solid C*-algebra results.

title: Approximation and quadratic strong-operator paving
one_line_claim: Proves that every self-adjoint element of a complex von Neumann algebra admits strong-operator paving relative to any maximal abelian subalgebra with O(ε^-2) blocks.
problem_status_before: Popa–Vaes paving conjecture
rating_reason: Quantitative paving after Kadison–Singer.

title: Trace cones and Razak–Jacelon stabilization
one_line_claim: Classifies separable nuclear complex C∗-algebras after tensoring with the Razak–Jacelon algebra and the compact operators, using their full topological cones of extended lower-semicontinuous tracial weights.
problem_status_before: Robert's trace-cone question
rating_reason: Specialist classification result.

title: Radius of comparison equals half the mean dimension
one_line_claim: For every minimal homeomorphism h of an infinite compact metrizable space X, the radius of comparison of C(X)rtimes_hℤ equals 1/2mdim(X,h), including infinite values.
problem_status_before: Toms–Phillips conjecture relating radius of comparison and mean dimension
rating_reason: Settles a known C*-dynamics conjecture.

title: Weak pure infiniteness and Cuntz-algebra absorption
one_line_claim: Resolves the ordinary-to-strong pure-infiniteness question of Kirchberg and Rørdam for complex C∗-algebras.
problem_status_before: Kirchberg–Rørdam pure-infiniteness question
rating_reason: Solid C*-algebra result.

title: The Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every dimension
one_line_claim: Every locally compact second-countable Hausdorff group acting faithfully and jointly continuously on a connected finite-dimensional topological manifold is a Lie group.
problem_status_before: Hilbert–Smith conjecture (generalized Hilbert fifth problem); known only in dimension ≤ 3 (Pardon 2013)
rating_reason: Settles a century-old problem in transformation groups.

title: Four-dimensional disk embedding and Wall's conjecture
one_line_claim: The unrestricted four-dimensional disk-embedding conjecture fails: framed algebraic dual spheres do not suffice to obtain disjoint locally flat spanning disks.
problem_status_before: Whether free groups are 'good' is the central open problem of 4D topological surgery; Wall's conjecture on PD groups
rating_reason: Would reshape 4-manifold topology.

title: The purely cosmetic surgery conjecture
one_line_claim: Distinct Dehn surgery slopes on a nontrivial smooth knot in S3 never produce orientation-preservingly homeomorphic manifolds, proving the purely cosmetic surgery conjecture.
problem_status_before: Purely cosmetic surgery conjecture (Gordon; Kirby problem 1.81A)
rating_reason: Settles a well-known knot theory conjecture.

title: Failure of rational injectivity for maximal coarse assembly
one_line_claim: Constructs a uniformly discrete bounded-geometry space whose maximal coarse assembly map is not rationally injective.
problem_status_before: Rational coarse Novikov conjecture (Higson–Roe)
rating_reason: Disproves a central coarse-geometry conjecture.

title: Finite Smith–Toda complexes at every height
one_line_claim: For every n ≥ 0, constructs a finite Smith–Toda spectrum at a prime p depending on n, with Brown–Peterson homology BP_*/(p,v_1,…,v_n) and the canonical comodule structure.
problem_status_before: Toda's question on Smith–Toda complexes V(n)
rating_reason: Answers a classical homotopy-theory question when the prime may vary.

title: The Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three
one_line_claim: Resolves the odd-primary Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three: exactly the standard classes with indices 0, 2, and 3 survive in the mod-three Adams spectral sequence, in stems 10, 106, and 322.
problem_status_before: Odd-primary Kervaire invariant problem (Ravenel)
rating_reason: Completes the p = 3 case.

title: Quillen's conjecture in rational homology
one_line_claim: Proves the rational-homology form of Quillen's conjecture for every finite group and every prime.
problem_status_before: Quillen's conjecture (1978); Aschbacher–Smith partial
rating_reason: Settles a famous conjecture in finite group theory in a strong form.

title: The Hovey–Strickland and Chai conjectures
one_line_claim: Proves Chai's invariant-ideal conjecture for Lubin–Tate deformation rings over finite residue fields, at every prime and positive height n.
problem_status_before: Hovey–Strickland and Chai conjectures
rating_reason: Important chromatic homotopy result.

title: The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis
one_line_claim: Proves the Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis for ∞-groupoids associated with every Grothendieck coherator in the Ara–Henry convention: these algebraic objects recover the homotopy theory of spaces.
problem_status_before: Grothendieck's homotopy hypothesis (Pursuing Stacks, 1983)
rating_reason: Settles a famous higher-category question in the Ara–Henry framework.

title: Finite generation for the K(n)-local sphere
one_line_claim: Answers the degreewise finiteness question of Hovey and Hovey–Strickland: every homotopy group of the K(n)-local sphere is a finitely generated ℤp-module, for every prime, positive height and integer degree.
problem_status_before: Hovey–Strickland finiteness question
rating_reason: Specialist chromatic result.

title: Cyclic length and chromatic fixed-point loss
one_line_claim: Determines the optimal chromatic loss from geometric H-fixed points to geometric G-fixed points for every subgroup H of a finite p-group G. At every nonnegative height, the loss equals the shortest subnormal-chain length from H to G with cyclic quotients.
problem_status_before: Equivariant chromatic questions
rating_reason: Specialist result.

title: The four-dimensional Singer conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves that the L2-Betti numbers of the universal cover of every closed connected aspherical topological four-manifold vanish outside degree two.
problem_status_before: Singer conjecture (1970s), open in dimension 4
rating_reason: Settles a well-known L²-topology conjecture.

title: Curtis’s conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves Curtis’s conjecture: the positive-degree mod-two stable Hurewicz image of the sphere is spanned by the images of the Hopf-invariant-one classes η, ν, σ and the Kervaire-invariant-one classes that exist.
problem_status_before: Curtis conjecture (1975) on the Hurewicz image
rating_reason: Settles a classical stable-homotopy conjecture.

title: Thomason model structures in all strict higher dimensions
one_line_claim: Resolves the Ara–Maltsiniotis conjecture: for every n ≥ 1 and n = ω, small strict globular n-categories admit proper combinatorial Thomason model structures Quillen equivalent to simplicial sets.
problem_status_before: Ara–Maltsiniotis conjecture
rating_reason: Specialist higher-category result.

title: Chromatic splitting: filtrations and counterexamples
one_line_claim: Disproves strong chromatic splitting at height three for primes p ≥ 5, and weak splitting for the derived p-completed sphere at heights p (p ≥ 5) and p+1 (p ≥ 7).
problem_status_before: Hopkins' chromatic splitting conjecture; Beaudry's failure at n = 2, p = 2
rating_reason: Clarifies a central chromatic conjecture.

title: Counterexamples to finite generation at chromatic height two
one_line_claim: Refutes the Hahn–Wilson conjecture at chromatic height two.
problem_status_before: Hahn–Wilson conjecture
rating_reason: Specialist counterexample.

title: Nonhomeomorphic closed aspherical four-manifolds
one_line_claim: Constructs closed connected aspherical topological four-manifolds that are homotopy equivalent but not homeomorphic, with a common word-hyperbolic fundamental group.
problem_status_before: Borel conjecture; known for hyperbolic groups in dimension ≥ 5 (Bartels–Lück); dimension 4 open
rating_reason: A counterexample to the Borel conjecture would be historic for manifold topology.

title: A counterexample to Wall's finite D(2) problem
one_line_claim: Constructs a finite connected three-dimensional CW complex whose universal cover has no integral homology above degree two and whose third cohomology vanishes for every local coefficient module, but which has no finite two-dimensional homotopy model.
problem_status_before: Wall's D(2) problem (1965)
rating_reason: Settles a famous low-dimensional homotopy problem.

title: Tingley’s sphere-isometry problem
one_line_claim: Resolves Tingley's problem: every surjective isometry between the unit spheres of nonzero real Banach spaces extends uniquely to a surjective real-linear isometry of the whole spaces.
problem_status_before: Tingley's problem (1987)
rating_reason: Settles a well-known Banach-space problem.

title: Independence of the separable quotient problem
one_line_claim: Establishes, relative to the consistency of a measurable cardinal, that the separable quotient problem is independent of ZFC. The assertion that every infinite-dimensional Banach space has a separable infinite-dimensional quotient can hold for all real and complex Banach spaces, whereas the continuum hypothesis yields counterexamples over both fields.
problem_status_before: Banach's separable quotient problem (1930s), one of the oldest in Banach space theory
rating_reason: Independence from ZFC settles a classic problem.
verification: Lean, partial (only the CH counterexample direction; the large-cardinal consistency direction is unformalized)

title: Lipschitz equivalent Banach spaces need not be linearly isomorphic
one_line_claim: Constructs separable real Banach spaces that are globally bi-Lipschitz equivalent but not linearly isomorphic, resolving the separable Lipschitz-isomorphism problem negatively.
problem_status_before: Lipschitz vs linear isomorphism for separable Banach spaces (Benyamini–Lindenstrauss)
rating_reason: Settles a central nonlinear-functional-analysis problem.

title: The complete Crouzeix conjecture
one_line_claim: Resolves the complete Crouzeix conjecture: for every bounded operator A on a complex Hilbert space and every finite matrix-valued polynomial P, one has ‖ P[A]‖≤2sup_z∈ W(A)‖ P(z)‖, where W(A) is the numerical range.
problem_status_before: Crouzeix conjecture (2004); best constant 1 + √2 (Crouzeix–Palencia 2017)
rating_reason: Settles a famous matrix-analysis conjecture.

title: The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property
one_line_claim: Resolves the cotype–cotype conjecture for real Banach spaces with the approximation property.
problem_status_before: Cotype–cotype conjecture
rating_reason: Partial resolution under the approximation property.

title: Markov type characterizes superreflexivity
one_line_claim: Proves that every real Banach space with Markov type p for some p &gt 1 admits an equivalent uniformly convex norm, answering Naor's renorming question.
problem_status_before: Naor's Markov type renorming question
rating_reason: Solid metric-geometry result.

title: Nonexpansive fixed points in reflexive Banach spaces
one_line_claim: Resolves Kirk's reflexive-space fixed-point problem: every nonexpansive selfmap of a nonempty closed bounded convex subset of a real reflexive Banach space has a fixed point.
problem_status_before: Kirk's fixed point problem for reflexive spaces (1965)
rating_reason: Settles a famous fixed-point problem.

title: A counterexample to metric-entropy duality
one_line_claim: Disproves Pietsch's dimension-free duality conjecture for metric entropy.
problem_status_before: Pietsch's duality conjecture for entropy numbers (1972)
rating_reason: Disproves a well-known conjecture.

title: A uniformly discrete counterexample to bounded approximation in Lipschitz-free spaces
one_line_claim: Constructs a countable uniformly discrete metric space whose real Lipschitz-free Banach space has the approximation property but not the bounded approximation property, answering Kalton's question negatively.
problem_status_before: Kalton's question on Lipschitz-free spaces
rating_reason: Specialist counterexample.

title: Reflexive midpoint convexity and diamond distortion
one_line_claim: Constructs a real reflexive Banach space with an asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex norm but no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm, extending Baudier's separation to reflexive spaces.
problem_status_before: Baudier-type renorming questions
rating_reason: Niche Banach-space construction.

title: Metric Markov cotype of ℓ1 and Hilbert-space Lipschitz extension
one_line_claim: Proves that real ℓ1 has metric Markov cotype two, answering Mendel and Naor's question.
problem_status_before: Mendel–Naor Markov cotype question; Ball's extension problem
rating_reason: Strong metric-geometry result.

title: Smooth isometric immersions of surfaces into ℝ4
one_line_claim: Every closed smooth Riemannian surface admits a smooth isometric immersion into ℝ4, resolving the closed-surface form of the four-dimensional isometric-immersion problem.
problem_status_before: Isometric immersion of surfaces in R⁴ (Gromov's question); R⁵ known
rating_reason: Settles a classical embedding problem.

title: A smooth surface metric with no local isometric immersion in ℝ3
one_line_claim: Constructs a smooth positive-definite metric on (-1,1)^2 for which no neighborhood of the origin admits a smooth isometric immersion into ℝ3.
problem_status_before: Local isometric embedding of smooth surfaces in R³ (Schläfli-era question)
rating_reason: Answers a famous local realization problem negatively.

title: Gromov’s integral scalar-curvature bound for simplicial volume
one_line_claim: Proves ∈t_M(Scal_g^-)^n/2dV_g≥ a_n‖ M‖ for every closed connected oriented smooth n-manifold, n ≥ 3, and every smooth metric, with a_n> 0 depending only on dimension.
problem_status_before: Gromov's simplicial-volume conjecture; aspherical PSC conjecture known only in dimension ≤ 5
rating_reason: Aspherical manifolds carrying no PSC in all dimensions would be a major geometry result.

title: Spectral scalar curvature, Urysohn width, and macroscopic dimension
one_line_claim: Every complete connected smooth boundaryless n-manifold, n ≥ 3, satisfying -4Δ+Scal≥1 as a quadratic-form inequality admits a continuous map to a simplicial complex of dimension at most n-2 whose entire fibers have diameter bounded only by n in the original metric.
problem_status_before: Gromov's macroscopic dimension conjecture for PSC manifolds
rating_reason: Major scalar-curvature result.

title: Sharp Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry and rigidity
one_line_claim: Proves generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry in every dimension: in a complete simply connected manifold with sectional curvature at most κ ≤ 0, every finite-volume finite-perimeter set satisfies the sharp comparison with the equal-volume model ball.
problem_status_before: Cartan–Hadamard conjecture (Aubin); dimensions ≤ 4 known, a claimed general proof by Ghomi–Spruck
rating_reason: Sharp isoperimetry on nonpositively curved spaces.
notable_flags: Lean-formalized. Prior status: Ghomi–Spruck claimed a proof (2019–22); novelty needs checking.

title: Yau's uniformization conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves Yau's uniformization conjecture: every complete connected noncompact Kähler manifold with strictly positive holomorphic bisectional curvature is biholomorphic to ℂn.
problem_status_before: Yau's uniformization conjecture (1970s); maximal volume growth case known (Liu)
rating_reason: Settles a famous Kähler-geometry conjecture.

title: Katok's entropy rigidity conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves Katok's entropy rigidity conjecture for closed connected Riemannian manifolds of dimension at least three with strictly negative sectional curvature: normalized Liouville measure maximizes entropy for the geodesic flow if and only if the metric is locally symmetric.
problem_status_before: Katok's entropy rigidity conjecture (1982)
rating_reason: Settles a famous rigidity conjecture.

title: A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture
one_line_claim: Disproves the unrestricted nearby Lagrangian conjecture.
problem_status_before: Arnold's nearby Lagrangian conjecture; Abouzaid–Kragh homotopy equivalence
rating_reason: Disproves a central symplectic-topology conjecture.

title: Donaldson's hypersymplectic deformation conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves Donaldson's hypersymplectic deformation conjecture in a cohomology-preserving form.
problem_status_before: Donaldson's hypersymplectic conjecture
rating_reason: Settles a known 4D geometry conjecture.

title: Donaldson's tamed-to-compatible conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves Donaldson's tamed-to-compatible conjecture: every smooth almost complex structure on a closed four-manifold that is tamed by a symplectic form admits a compatible symplectic form.
problem_status_before: Donaldson's tamed-to-compatible question (2006); known for b⁺ = 1
rating_reason: Settles a famous 4D symplectic question.

title: Symplectic ball packing in higher dimensions
one_line_claim: Resolves the Siegel–Yao conjecture for arbitrary capacities in every dimension 2n≥6.
problem_status_before: Symplectic ball packing in dimension ≥ 6
rating_reason: Major symplectic embedding result.

title: The metric Blaschke conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves the metric Blaschke conjecture: every closed connected Riemannian manifold of positive dimension whose injectivity radius equals its diameter is, up to scaling, a standard compact rank-one symmetric space.
problem_status_before: Blaschke conjecture; known for spheres (Berger)
rating_reason: Settles a classical Riemannian-geometry conjecture.

title: Infinitely many closed geodesics on Riemannian spheres and closed three-manifolds
one_line_claim: Proves that every smooth Riemannian metric on Sn, n ≥ 2, has infinitely many prime closed geodesics with pairwise distinct images.
problem_status_before: Infinitely many closed geodesics known on S² (Franks, Bangert); open on Sⁿ, n ≥ 3
rating_reason: Settles a famous problem in Riemannian geometry and dynamics.

title: Sharp singular-set bounds for stationary integral varifolds
one_line_claim: Proves that every stationary integral m-varifold in a Euclidean open set has singular set of Hausdorff dimension at most m-1, a sharp bound in every positive dimension and codimension.
problem_status_before: Regularity of stationary integral varifolds, open since Allard (1972)
rating_reason: A central open problem of geometric measure theory.

title: Counterexamples to stable-Morse and strong Arnold fixed-point bounds
one_line_claim: Disproves stable-Morse lower bounds for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points: on simply connected closed Kähler manifolds of real dimension 22, the deficit below the stable Morse number is unbounded.
problem_status_before: Strong Arnold conjecture on fixed points vs critical points
rating_reason: Counterexamples to a well-known symplectic conjecture.
verification: Lean, partial (one counterexample formalized; the stable-Morse construction is not)

title: Nonnegative-curvature Einstein classification and an L2 topological gap
one_line_claim: Classifies closed connected Einstein four-manifolds with positive Einstein constant and nonnegative sectional curvature: up to scaling, their universal Riemannian covers are the round S4, Fubini–Study ℂP^2, or a product of equal round two-spheres.
problem_status_before: Classification of Einstein 4-manifolds under curvature conditions
rating_reason: Solid geometric classification.

title: The Solomon–Yau least-volume conjecture
one_line_claim: Proves the Solomon–Yau least-volume conjecture for minimal hypersurfaces of round spheres.
problem_status_before: Solomon–Yau conjecture
rating_reason: Settles a known minimal-surface conjecture.

title: Yau’s nodal bounds: surfaces and higher dimensions
one_line_claim: Proves the sharp C√λ upper bound for nodal length on every fixed smooth closed surface, completing Yau's conjecture there.
problem_status_before: Yau's nodal-set conjecture; Logunov's lower bound and polynomial upper bound (2018)
rating_reason: Proves the sharp bound on surfaces and disproves it for smooth metrics in dimensions 3–5, a startling reversal.
notable_flags: Lean-formalized (counterexample part per Comparator; check scope).

title: Scalar curvature and finite-time Ricci-flow singularities
one_line_claim: Proves that a smooth Ricci flow on a closed four-manifold extends past any finite time at which scalar curvature remains uniformly bounded.
problem_status_before: Scalar curvature extension conjecture for Ricci flow
rating_reason: Settles it in 4D and disproves it in general.

title: A finite-time singularity of Calabi flow
one_line_claim: Disproves Chen's smooth long-time existence conjecture for Calabi flow by constructing a smooth U(10)-invariant Kähler metric on ℂP^10 whose flow develops a finite-time singularity.
problem_status_before: Chen's Calabi flow conjecture
rating_reason: Disproves a known geometric-flow conjecture.

title: Affine Bernstein rigidity through dimension nine and a smooth dimension-ten counterexample
one_line_claim: Proves that every smooth locally uniformly convex affine-maximal graph of dimension three through nine, complete for its induced Euclidean metric, is an elliptic paraboloid.
problem_status_before: Chern's affine Bernstein problem; Trudinger–Wang in dimension 2
rating_reason: Sharp classification with a counterexample.

title: The isoperimetric profile of the cubic three-torus
one_line_claim: Determines the isoperimetric profile of the unit cubic flat three-torus and classifies every finite-perimeter minimizer: balls, circular tubes around shortest closed geodesics, coordinate slabs, and their complements.
problem_status_before: Isoperimetric profile of flat 3-tori
rating_reason: Settles a classical problem.

title: Unique tangent flows at the first surface singularity
one_line_claim: Proves the first-singular-time case of tangent-flow uniqueness for smooth compact connected embedded surfaces without boundary in ℝ3.
problem_status_before: Uniqueness of tangent flows (Ilmanen); Colding–Minicozzi cylindrical case
rating_reason: Important mean-curvature-flow result.

title: Gigli’s characterization of Alexandrov curvature
one_line_claim: Proves Gigli's conjecture: in every integer dimension n ≥ 2, Alexandrov curvature at least κ is characterized by the full-support mathopRCDnolimits ((n-1)κ,n) condition with reference measure H^n and distributional sectional curvature at least κ in the original global test classes.
problem_status_before: Gigli's conjecture
rating_reason: Specialist metric-measure result.

title: Bi-Lipschitz coordinates at every regular RCD point
one_line_claim: Proves that every regular point of a noncollapsed mathopRCDnolimits (K,n) space, for K ∈ ℝ and integer n ≥ 2, has an open neighborhood bi-Lipschitz to an open subset of ℝn.
problem_status_before: RCD regularity
rating_reason: Specialist result.

title: A three-manifold without conjugate points or nonpositive curvature
one_line_claim: Constructs a closed connected orientable smooth three-manifold that admits a metric without conjugate points but no metric of nonpositive sectional curvature.
problem_status_before: Conjugate points vs nonpositive curvature
rating_reason: Answers a known question.

title: Negative Kähler curvature without bounded holomorphic coordinates
one_line_claim: Constructs a contractible domain in ℂ3 with a complete negatively pinched Kähler metric but no bounded holomorphic coordinates, disproving bounded-domain uniformization in this setting.
problem_status_before: Greene–Wu / Siu–Yau bounded-domain question for negatively curved Kähler manifolds
rating_reason: Disproves a famous expectation.

title: Weak MTW curvature gives convexity and regular optimal transport
one_line_claim: On every closed connected Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two satisfying weak Ma–Trudinger–Wang curvature, all tangent injectivity domains are convex, resolving Villani’s conjecture in this setting.
problem_status_before: Villani's MTW convexity conjecture
rating_reason: Settles a known optimal-transport conjecture.

title: Failure of integer-degree harmonic dimension comparison
one_line_claim: Disproves Yau's proposed Euclidean dimension bound for harmonic functions of integer growth on manifolds with nonnegative Ricci curvature.
problem_status_before: Yau/Colding–Minicozzi harmonic-function dimension question
rating_reason: Disproves a well-known proposed bound.

title: Global smoothness for relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell
one_line_claim: Proves large-data global existence and uniqueness for the three-dimensional, one-species relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system.
problem_status_before: Glassey–Strauss (1986) large-data problem for 3D relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell, a central open problem in kinetic theory
rating_reason: Global smoothness for arbitrary large data would be a landmark PDE result.
notable_flags: Lean-formalized (extraordinary for PDE; check scope). Reasoning trace released. Comparator statement read by researcher6 (global classical smooth unique solution for large data); faithful to the claim.

title: Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation
one_line_claim: Constructs two distinct global entropy solutions of the three-dimensional periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation from the same nonnegative initial density, with bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy and absolute entropy.
problem_status_before: Uniqueness of Boltzmann weak solutions
rating_reason: Striking nonuniqueness result.

title: Kinetic limits and fluctuations over the Boltzmann lifespan
one_line_claim: Derives the nonlinear Boltzmann equation from three-dimensional grand-canonical Newtonian gases throughout every regular kinetic interval with uniform Gaussian decay.
problem_status_before: Deng–Hani–Ma (2024) derived Boltzmann for hard spheres over the full lifespan
rating_reason: Extends a recent breakthrough to potentials and fluctuations.

title: Joint metric and connection recovery from one boundary patch
one_line_claim: Zero-frequency measurements on any nonempty open boundary patch determine a smooth metric and smooth unitary connection on a trivial Hermitian rank-two bundle over a compact connected manifold of dimension at least three, up to diffeomorphism and gauge fixed on that patch.
problem_status_before: Smooth anisotropic Calderón problem open in dimension ≥ 3; L^∞ conductivity uniqueness open in 3D
rating_reason: Joint metric recovery plus a 3D nonuniqueness counterexample would be major for inverse problems.
verification: Lean, partial (only the 3D conductivity nonuniqueness; metric/connection recovery is unformalized)

title: The planar Mumford–Shah regularity conjecture and local weak-L4 gradient bounds
one_line_claim: Resolves the interior regularity conjecture for reduced absolute planar Mumford–Shah minimizers with bounded fidelity data.
problem_status_before: Mumford–Shah conjecture (1989)
rating_reason: Settles a famous calculus-of-variations conjecture in the plane.

title: The critical dimension for the one-phase Bernoulli problem
one_line_claim: Establishes seven as the first dimension admitting a nonflat, one-homogeneous global minimizer of the one-phase Bernoulli energy.
problem_status_before: Bernoulli problem: smooth up to dim 4 (Jerison–Savin), singular cone in dim 7 (De Silva–Jerison)
rating_reason: Pins down the critical dimension.
verification: Lean, partial (supporting statement only; regularity through dimension 6 unformalized)

title: The three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem
one_line_claim: Resolves the three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem: every W^1,p homeomorphism between arbitrary bounded domains in ℝ3, for 1≤ p< ∞, is a strong W^1,p limit of smooth diffeomorphisms onto the same target.
problem_status_before: Ball–Evans approximation problem
rating_reason: Settles a known nonlinear-elasticity problem.

title: The hot spots conjecture for simply connected planar domains
one_line_claim: Proves a strict form of Burdzy's simply connected hot spots conjecture.
problem_status_before: Rauch's hot spots conjecture (1974); triangles by Judge–Mondal (2020)
rating_reason: Settles a famous spectral-geometry conjecture for simply connected planar domains.

title: The Lane–Emden and Hénon–Lane–Emden conjectures
one_line_claim: Resolves the subcritical Lane–Emden conjecture and its weighted Hénon extension.
problem_status_before: Lane–Emden conjecture; known for n ≤ 4 (Souplet)
rating_reason: Settles a well-known Liouville-type conjecture.

title: Stable blowup for the defocusing Schrödinger equation
one_line_claim: For a sufficiently large odd nonlinearity power, constructs a nonempty open set of initial data in H^k(𝕋^12), with k &gt 8, whose solutions of the scalar defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation blow up in finite time.
problem_status_before: Defocusing NLS blowup (Merle–Raphaël–Rodnianski–Szeftel 2022)
rating_reason: Stable blowup is a striking strengthening.

title: Global uniqueness in smooth isotropic elasticity
one_line_claim: Proves that full static boundary displacement-to-traction data determine both smooth real Lamé moduli on every bounded connected smooth domain in ℝ3, provided μ &gt 0 and 3λ+2μ> 0 on the closure.
problem_status_before: Lamé parameter recovery in 3D without smallness
rating_reason: Settles a known inverse-problems question.

title: Nonattainment of the three-marginal Coulomb Monge problem
one_line_claim: An optimal three-particle Coulomb configuration need not be a deterministic function of the first particle, even for smooth identical spatial densities.
problem_status_before: Seidl's strictly-correlated-electrons conjecture
rating_reason: Answers a DFT/transport question negatively.

title: Sharp one-third stability of Brenier maps
one_line_claim: For uniform source measure ρ on a compact convex body with interior in dimension at least two, quadratic optimal transport maps satisfy ‖T_μ-T_nu‖_L^2(rho)≤ C W_2(μ,nu)^1/3 uniformly over targets in a fixed compact set.
problem_status_before: Letrouit's stability conjecture
rating_reason: Sharp transport stability exponent.

title: De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight
one_line_claim: Proves De Giorgi's conjecture at its sharp dimension-eight endpoint: every entire C2 solution u:ℝ^8→(-1,1) of Δ u=u^3-u that is strictly increasing in one direction depends on only one linear coordinate.
problem_status_before: De Giorgi's conjecture; Savin (2009) under a limit assumption
rating_reason: Settles the sharp-dimension case of a famous conjecture.

title: Universal computation in forced Navier–Stokes flows
one_line_claim: Constructs viscous incompressible flows starting from rest on a fixed flat three-dimensional domain that perform universal computation under smooth external forcing.
problem_status_before: Tao's Navier–Stokes computation program
rating_reason: Interesting, but forcing makes universality less surprising.

title: Interior C^1,α regularity for infinity-harmonic functions
one_line_claim: Proves uniform interior C^1,α_d regularity for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension d ≥ 3, for a positive exponent depending only on dimension.
problem_status_before: C^{1,α} for infinity-harmonic functions known only in 2D (Evans–Savin); differentiability by Evans–Smart
rating_reason: Settles a famous regularity problem.
